decisions.reason: The combined magazining, cleaning and plotting machine was launched only in 2024 and extends the firm's core automated precast line, so management will see weak early results as start-up effects and keep investing in it, even though the 2023 robots were quickly removed from the website.

The production analysis software is cheap to keep, fits the publicly announced shift toward digital, future-ready precast production, and adds value to the firm's control and lifecycle offering, so dropping it would undercut the strategy management has committed to.
